s01: Hello again, my friend! (pause) Yesterday, Tala saved her new book. (pause) We named a book, a notebook, a desk, and a pencil. (pause) Today, we draw!
words: Let us get ready to draw. (pause) We need three more tools to draw. (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap each picture and say the word!
words-1: Paper. (pause) We write and draw on paper.
words-2: Eraser. (pause) An eraser fixes our mistakes.
words-3: Ruler. (pause) A ruler helps us draw straight lines.
words-4: And our friend from yesterday, the pencil!
act: You know the drawing tools! Now let us use them. (pause) Let us pretend to draw! (pause) I say it. (pause) You act it out!
act-1: Hold your paper! (pause) Hold it flat.
act-2: Draw a line! (pause) Slide your pencil along the ruler.
find: Good drawing! Now use your ears. (pause) Listen carefully. (pause) Tap the right picture.
find-q1: Where is the eraser? Tap it!
find-q2: Where is the ruler? Tap it!
short-e: Yesterday we sang a, e, i, o, u. Today we sing the e sound! (pause) Remember, e, e, egg? (pause) Listen for e, e in these words. (pause) Tap a line and say it with me!
e-tap: Ten red pens! Can you find more e words? (pause) Listen for e, e. (pause) Tap the word with the short e sound!
e-tap-q1: Pen. (pause) Bag. (pause) Which one has e, e?
e-tap-q1-yes: Yes! p, e, n. (pause) Pen has the short e!
e-tap-q2: Desk. (pause) Book. (pause) Which one has e, e?
e-tap-q2-yes: Yes! d, e, sk. (pause) Desk has the short e too!
s1: Now let us read a story about a ruler. (pause) Story time! (pause) Our story is Bunso's Ruler. (pause) It is drawing time. (pause) Teacher Ana says, draw a straight line with your ruler.
s2: What does Bunso do with his ruler? (pause) But Bunso does not draw. (pause) He waves his ruler like a sword! (pause) Swish, swish! (pause) Look, I am a hero, he says.
mid: Hmm. Is that the right way to use a ruler? (pause) Quick question!
mid-q1-yes: Yes! A ruler is for straight lines. (pause) Not for sword play!
s3: Then something happens. (pause) Swish! (pause) Snap! (pause) The ruler hits the desk. (pause) It breaks in two! (pause) Now Bunso cannot draw a straight line.
feel: Oh no! Let us stop and think. (pause) His ruler is broken. (pause) How does Bunso feel?
feel-q1-yes: Yes! Bunso is sad. (pause) Who can help him?
s4: Who helps Bunso? (pause) Tala says, you can use my ruler. (pause) Please be careful. (pause) Thank you, Ate! (pause) I am sorry I played with my ruler.
s5: Now Bunso can draw! (pause) Bunso draws a straight line. (pause) He erases a mistake, gently. (pause) He uses both sides of the paper. (pause) Tools are for working, not for playing!
order: That is the end of the story. Can you retell it? (pause) Let us retell the story. (pause) Tap the pictures in order. (pause) Beginning. (pause) Middle. (pause) End.
order-1: Beginning: Bunso plays with his ruler.
order-3: End: Bunso uses the ruler the right way.
order-yes: Beginning, middle, end! (pause) You retold the whole story!
right-way: Bunso learned the right way. Do you know it too? (pause) Let us be like Bunso at the end. (pause) Tap the right way to use our tools!
right-way-q1: Look at the eraser. (pause) Which is the right way?
right-way-q1-yes: Yes! We erase gently, so the paper does not tear.
right-way-q2: Look at the ruler. (pause) Which is the right way?
right-way-q2-yes: Yes! A ruler helps us draw a straight line.
my-tool: Now you tell me how YOU use a tool! (pause) Pick one tool. (pause) Tell me how you use it. (pause) Say: I use an eraser to fix my mistake. (pause) Your turn!
my-tool-example: I use a ruler to draw a line.
verse: Bunso learned to care for his tools. The Bible says that is important. (pause) Our Bible verse again! (pause) A ruler is a small thing. (pause) When we use it with care, we can be trusted!
verse-verse: Whoever can be trusted with very little (pause) can also be trusted with much. (pause) Luke sixteen, verse ten.
done: You worked so hard today! (pause) Hooray! (pause) You named three drawing tools. (pause) You found the short e sound. (pause) And you use tools the right way! (pause) Tomorrow, we color with crayons!
fx-try-2: Look again. You can do it!
fx-cheer-1: Hi! You are doing so well!
fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
fx-still-1: Good listening! Simon did not say it.
fx-oops-1: Oops! Simon did not say it. Stay still next time!
fx-doit-1: Simon said it! Let us do it!
